description: This file contains utility functions for cryptographic operations related to generating and decrypting organization identifiers using AES encryption with a tenant-specific salt. It includes functions for converting hex strings to CryptoJS word arrays, generating encrypted organization IDs, decrypting them, and validating the tenant salt.

methods.name: hexToWordArray(hex)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a CryptoJS WordArray suitable for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId(email)
methods.description: Generates an encrypted organization ID by AES-128-ECB encrypting a normalized email with a tenant-specific salt, then encoding the ciphertext into a URL-safe Base64 string.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId(encUrlEncoded)
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted organization ID (URL-encoded Base64 ciphertext) back into the original email, using the tenant's salt.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid()
methods.description: Checks whether the tenant salt is present and non-empty.
